title: 3 Reasons Your Portfolio Could Be Failing (Brian Wang)
topic: Investing in Canada: inflation, active funds trailing the TSX, tax structure (TFSA vs non-registered)
hook: 3 REASONS YOUR PORTFOLIO COULD BE FAILING (two-line headline in the strap over Brian on frame 1)
